title.purpose: Sub-section headers, Roadmap detail panel headers.

colophon.purpose: Header wordmark only. Never spreads to body headlines.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for button/link hover transitions (220ms).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Square corners, near-black fill, gold-deep hover.
components.html: Find an event near you
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #1C1209; color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8B6914; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4A84A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary call-to-action. Transparent fill, near-black border, gold-deep hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #1C1209; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid #1C1209; border-radius: 0; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1), color 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #8B6914; color: #8B6914; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4A84A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Level Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped badge marking a Roadmap level; each level has its own saturated bg/text color pair. Shown here as Level 1: The Exodus.
components.css: .ds-badge-level-1 { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.20em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #1D4D2A; color: #A8D4B2; }

components.name: Vanguard Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped badge for Vanguard status, deliberately outside the four level colors.
components.css: .ds-badge-vanguard { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #C4A84A; color: #8B6914; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.20em; text-transform: uppercase; background: transparent; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default content card. Flat, square corners, parchment-card surface, gold-deep border on hover. No shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ECE6D6; border: 1px solid #D9D0B8; border-radius: 0; padding: 32px; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #8B6914; }

components.name: Gilt Edge Card
components.description: Signature component. A default Card with the gilt page-edge accent on its right side, simulating a leather-bound book's gilt edge.
components.css: .ds-gilt-edge { position: relative; } .ds-gilt-edge::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: -3px; width: 3px; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8B6914 0%, #C4A84A 30%, #8B6914 55%, #C4A84A 80%, #8B6914 100%); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Stamp Frame (light)
components.description: Signature component. Diagonal corner-bracket frame (top-left + bottom-right only) reading as military-coordinate/field-manual marks. Light variant has no full border, used in Hero/CTA contexts.
components.css: .ds-stamp-light { position: relative; padding: 24px; margin: 32px 0; } .ds-stamp-light::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -5px; left: -5px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #C4A84A; border-left: 1px solid #C4A84A; } .ds-stamp-light::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -5px; right: -5px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #C4A84A; border-right: 1px solid #C4A84A; }

narrative.overview: TFM's visual language is a leather-bound Bible — a document of lasting consequence, handled repeatedly, passed from person to person. Every page is a page in that book: parchment ground, hand-tooled leather header, gilt page-edge on cards, a crimson ribbon bookmark, a gold spine strip running the full height of the viewport. The system reads as issued and earned, never sold — closer to a field manual or a credential than a product marketing site. The voice this system carries is the Sanctuary Voice: real threats named plainly, resolved to agency and ownership rather than left in dread. Visually this means the system can go dark and heavy (the leather header, the near-black CTA bands) without ever reading as menacing — the gold accents and parchment warmth are the sanctuary the dark sections resolve into.
keyCharacteristics: Parchment-and-leather material world: warm off-white pages, dark leather surfaces, gold gilt accents, crimson as a single sparing highlight.
Sharp corners everywhere except pill-shaped badges (the one deliberate exception).
Serif (EB Garamond) for weight-bearing text, sans (Inter) for labels/body/UI, Cinzel reserved for the header wordmark only.
The ◆ diamond is the recurring reference mark.
Four Roadmap levels each carry their own saturated bg/text color pair, distinct from the core palette.

rules.name: The Leather Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces (#2A1F0E) are reserved for header, footer, and register-shift section bands — never a default background.

rules.name: The Crimson Rule
rules.body: Crimson appears only as the ribbon-bookmark motif, never as a general accent, button, link, or badge color.

rules.name: The Proclamation Rule
rules.body: A heading pairs a bold, near-black declarative clause with an italic, gold-deep resolution clause below it — the visual form of the Sanctuary Voice's stakes-then-agency pattern.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add box-shadow for elevation. Use the gilt-edge treatment or a stamp-frame instead.

dos: Do use EB Garamond for anything meant to feel earned, historical, or declarative.
Do use the ◆ diamond as the recurring mark for reference points, dividers, and list bullets.
Do reserve Cinzel exclusively for the header wordmark.
Do use the gilt-edge or stamp-frame treatments for anything that needs to read as elevated or important.
Do give Level badges their own saturated bg/text color pair per level, kept out of the rest of the palette.
donts: Don't add box-shadow anywhere for elevation.
Don't round corners on buttons or cards — pill badges are the one confirmed exception.
Don't use blue, pastels, gradients outside the gilt/gold system, glassmorphism, or full-bleed stock photography.
Don't use crimson as a general accent.

Don't let Sanctuary Voice stakes language go unresolved on a page — every dark/heavy visual passage should carry copy that resolves to agency, matching the visual resolution from leather back to parchment/gold.
